question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **High**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The blank is asking for an appropriate option to fill in the fourth space.
 
• The word "high" is appropriate in this context because it accurately describes the elevated or considerable level of cholesterol found in eggs.
 
• "High" is the best choice as it completes the sequence of increasing levels.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
